systems.label: Human health governance
systems.description: Scheduled governance, preparedness, treaty, budget and regional public-health processes whose primary institutional function is human health.

systems.label: Animal and zoonotic health
systems.description: Animal-health governance, surveillance, standards and disease-control systems, including zoonotic interfaces.

systems.label: Plant and phytosanitary security
systems.description: Plant-health governance, phytosanitary standards, pest prevention and related safe-trade systems.

systems.label: Biological security and arms control
systems.description: Governance addressing biological and toxin weapons, deliberate biological-agent misuse and associated disarmament obligations.

relationships.label: One Health
relationships.note: A cross-system analytical relationship. It does not replace an event's natural primary category or force every member of the connected systems to be labelled One Health.

canonical_series_memberships.basis: Existing canonical pandemic-governance / PABS negotiation series.

candidate_nodes.authority_basis: WOAH describes itself as the global authority on animal health and operates international animal-disease information and standards systems.

candidate_nodes.institution: International Plant Protection Convention / Commission on Phytosanitary Measures
candidate_nodes.authority_basis: IPPC is the international plant-health treaty; CPM is its governing body and adopts international phytosanitary standards.
The BWC prohibits biological and toxin weapons and is a multilateral disarmament / WMD governance system supported by UNODA.

candidate_nodes.institution: Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention
candidate_nodes.authority_basis: Africa CDC is an autonomous African Union health agency mandated to strengthen prevention, detection and response to public-health threats; its current institutional aspiration explicitly invokes One Health.
candidate_nodes.next_gate: Resolve authoritative event-date conflicts before any canonical admission.

notes: The overlay describes cross-domain analytical relationships; it does not change canonical event categories.
Only series already present in canonical v0.20 are mapped as canonical memberships.
Candidate nodes are research backlog objects only and intentionally carry no series_id or occurrence_id.
No event population is authorized by this dataset.
